summary: Every legal input contains exactly five distinct cards drawn from fixed rank and suit domains, so no scalable structural input size exists for an honest runtime verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: ranks and suits both always contain exactly five entries

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference checks five suits, counts five ranks in a fixed 14-slot table, and scans that fixed table once.

Regression checks all 371,293 five-position rank sequences, excluding only impossible fivefold ranks while assigning distinct suits per repeated rank, plus all 1,024 suit sequences with distinct ranks; branch separability covers every legal five-card hand.
